:::{#exm-optimization-algorithm}
#### Exact and exhaustive searches

For the residual sum of squares over the polynomials in @exm-objective-function,
solving the [normal equations](correlation-regression.qmd#def-normal-equations) is an [optimization algorithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/optimization.html#def-optimization-algorithm) $\optalg$
that finds the unique minimizer in one step.

Trying every member of a finite model family and keeping the one with the smallest value of the objective function is another,
and it ends after the last member.

:::
